QuestInfo.name: Catch a Bigfoot by the Toe 2
QuestInfo.0: With all the strange occurrences in Masteria and New Leaf City, Lita Lawless must be busy! I'll bet that she's willing to accept my help...maybe I can earn some mesos in the process! A quick jaunt to the Kerning City subway and I'll be on my way to New Leaf City!
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Lita, and I'm pretty sure I'm getting the short end of the stick on this one. I have to venture into the Phantom Forest and find this creature they've named #o9400575# and claim its toe as proof I defeated him. Everyone else who's gone after this thing has never come back - I'd better stock up on potions and keep my guard up-who knows when it could appear?
QuestInfo.2: I found this mysterious creature, and Lita wasn't kidding when she said it wrecked everyone that came after it! Although, when I was fighting it, I got the feeling that the Leprechaun on its back was just luring him into things...maybe it just doesn't know better? At any rate, I returned the toe to Lita and claimed the bounty.

item.0: Hmm, looks like you're not yet finished.  I asked you to beat the #o9400575# and bring me #t4032013# as proof. I can understand if you want to rest; just be sure to get them all before you return to me.
